svg.text: MoMo SMS Analytics · Entity Relationship Diagram
MySQL 8.0+ / InnoDB · Crow’s-foot notation · Clive Tanaka Mushipe · Week 2
Part of composite PK and a foreign key
Junction table resolving an M:N relationship
A user takes part in many transactions; a transaction involves
many users (a sender and a receiver). Resolved by
transaction_participants, which qualifies each link with a role.
A transaction carries many tags; a tag is applied to many
transactions. Resolved by transaction_tags, whose composite PK
(transaction_id, tag_id) also carries the relationship's own
